name: Telemetry::budget

test_list.description: A budget without usd and tokens limits is always Ok.
Usage below the warn percentage is Ok.
Exactly 80% of the limit (default threshold) is Warn with used_pct 80; just below is Ok.
Usage equal to or above the limit is Exceeded.
The report carries a status per limit; budget() is the worse of the two.
Token usage is prompt + completion; cached tokens are a subset of prompt and are not added.
with_warn_pct(50) warns at 50%; 0 and values above 100 are InvalidWarnPercent.
A limit of zero is exceeded by any usage including none (nothing may be spent).
Evaluating the budget on a published snapshot gives the same report as on the live telemetry.
proptest: for a fixed limit and threshold, more usage never gives a milder status (Ok < Warn < Exceeded) and used_pct stays below 100 while not exceeded.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Optional usd and token limits plus the warn percentage.

output_description: Ok, Warn { used_pct } or Exceeded; warn-only, enforcement is the kernel's job.
